subject: Request: short runway addendum for Northbridge POC
messages:
From: Sara Long <sara@northbridge.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Northbridge Procurement <procurement@northbridge.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Short runway addendum request for POC

Hi Irene,

Quick note from our side — we hit a delay ingesting our historical logs (third-party export took longer than expected) and the team won't be able to complete the second validation week of the POC within the current 30-day window. Can we please request a short runway addendum of 10–14 calendar days?

Two things we're evaluating as options on our side: a) extend the existing POC by +14 days with the same scope, or b) keep the end date fixed but accept a pro-rated credit for the missed validation week so we can run the tests after the contract period and turn on production once validated.

From Procurement: if extension is possible, they'd like a minimal amendment (no pricing re-negotiation) or, if there's a fee, a small one-time invoice works. We also attached the POC spec so you can see the impacted validation items.

Appreciate a quick read — our pilot deadline is the 15th and we'd like to lock this today if possible.

Thanks,
Sara Long
Director of ML Ops
Northbridge AI

Attachments: Northbridge-POC-specs.pdf (1.2MB)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Long <sara@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short runway addendum request for POC

Hi Sara — thanks for the heads up and for the spec. Sorry to hear about the export delay. We can accommodate a short runway addendum; to keep this light and avoid legal churn I propose two pragmatic paths: 

Option A — Time-extension: +14 calendar days added to the existing POC (no change to scope, same SKU/pricing). We'll provide a short amendment that both teams can sign electronically. This is our preference for speed.

Option B — Credit: convert the missed validation week into a one-time usage credit equal to the pro-rated token/compute estimated cost. Northbridge would run the tests post-POC and we’d reserve the credit for activation within 60 days.

Operational notes: for Option A we usually add a small administrative invoice ($250) to cover the extended reserved capacity window for dedicated pools — waived for enterprise customers on committed plans but applies for self-serve pilots. If you prefer a pure amendment with no invoice let me know and I'll route this for finance approval (may add a 24–48h delay).

I’m copying Karthik to confirm there’s capacity in us-west and Marcus to draft the amendment. If you approve Option A, we’ll push the amendment and a one-page invoice stub by EOD.

Best,
Irene
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Runway-Addendum-draft.pdf (3 pages)

Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Short runway addendum request for POC

Irene — we have spare capacity in the us-west pool for the requested window (14 days). No disruptions expected to other bookings if we slot them in the low-traffic overnight batch windows.

Marcus — for the amendment, can you keep the wording tight: start/end dates, unchanged scope, acceptance criteria unchanged, and an administrative fee stanza that defaults to $0 if a sales credit is approved within 48 hours? That saves us an extra legal loop.

I can also approve waiving the admin charge for this one if you want to accelerate. Let me know.

—Karthik
Principal Infra Product Manager
Redwood Inference

Irene — thanks for the quick reply and for laying out options. Northbridge prefers Option A (add +14 days) and is comfortable with a nominal admin fee if it helps speed this through.

Can you please send the amendment and the invoice stub today? Procurement will run the internal approval as soon as they have a one-pager to attach to the purchase request. Our target: get signatures by Monday 11 Oct to avoid blocking the validation run on Tue 12 Oct.

Thanks,
Sara

Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Runway addendum and invoice stub (NB-2027-0042)

Hi Sara / Procurement — attaching the one-page amendment and invoice stub as requested. Per our thread: +14 calendar days starting 2027-10-16 through 2027-10-29, no change to scope or acceptance criteria, administrative fee $150 (one-time). We have marked the fee as refundable as a sales credit if Northbridge converts to a paid deployment within 90 days; language added to the amendment.

Next steps: please confirm acceptance by reply and I'll route the DocuSign. Procurement, if you want the invoice formatted for PR-1098 please confirm billing details and I'll loop finance.

Thanks again — happy to jump on a 15-minute call if you want to run through the amendment quickly.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
